name: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited
summary: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited provides contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries worldwide. It operates through Integrated CDMO Platform and Marketable Molecules segments.
